peer_review_model.notes: Double-anonymized peer review for both Stage 1 and Stage 2.

article_types.description: Empirical articles where hypotheses, methods, and planned analyses undergo peer review before the research is conducted. Suitable for hypothesis-driven quantitative research, data-based resources, methods comparisons, and secondary analyses of existing data sets.

total_word_limit.notes: No word limit stated in the text -- confirmed absence, not something unchecked.

article_types.reference_style: Complete references including article titles and page ranges; DOI, Math Reviews (MathSciNet), and Zentralblatt MATH numbers included where available; arXiv number or URL for unpublished references.
required_statements: Statement confirming all necessary support and approvals are in place
Anticipated timeline for completing the study
Statement confirming no prior access to data (if applicable)
Statement confirming data and materials sharing
article_types.notes: Two-stage review process: Stage 1 (hypotheses, methods, and planned analyses) and Stage 2 (final manuscript with results and discussion).

remarks: No article processing charges (out of scope for this schema, noted here since it was explicitly stated in the text).
